values.note: 2026, for 2 people: water and electric $60, full hookup $70; primitive tent $45. Extra adults $8, children 4-13 $5.

fees.source: https://campindiantrail.com/2026-rates.html ('2026 Camping Rates / Price Includes 2 People / Full Hook-Up $ 70.00 / Water & Electric $ 60.00'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://campindiantrail.com/2026-rates.html ('Full Hook-Up', 'Water & Electric'), read 2026-10-30; electric 50 from the park's association listing https://www.ohiocamper.com/indiantrail.html ('30 and 50 amp service', 'Max. AMP's available for hookup 50')

values.note: Military: 25% off nightly rates, one site only.

discounts.source: https://campindiantrail.com/2026-rates.html ('Military Discount- 25% off nightly rates (Applies to one camp site only)'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations take one night's payment (three nights on holidays); refunds with 7 days' notice, 2 weeks on holiday weekends. Check-in 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://campindiantrail.com/2026-rates.html ('Reservations require one night paid / Holiday reservations require three nights paid'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-30; no online booking on the site

note: Family owned since 1986. Pool + 8-acre fishing lake with paddleboats; hike to the Indian Mound. --Claude
summary: Found the park's own site (campindiantrail.com). Added fees $60 (W/E) - $70 (FHU) for 2 people, military 25% off (confirmed), phone booking; confirmed water/sewer and 50-amp (association listing). Note trimmed of site counts, amps and season now in fields.
flags: PRICE GATE (drop candidate): cheapest RV site is $60/night for 2 (water & electric; full hookup $70), 2026 rates on the park's own page. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: none; Cleveland 80 km); not a Good Sam park (discounts.good_sam false); the 25% military discount is not a gate exception.
Google Maps: 4.6 from 248 reviews (Indian Trail Campground, 1400 US-250, New London; +1 419-929-1135; campindiantrail.com).
Website: replace https://www.ohiocamper.com/indiantrail.html (directory) with the park's own http://www.campindiantrail.com/.

Seasonal share unknown: seasonal sites from $2,445 (2027 lottery for open sites, 2014+ campers, 4 nights/week max) but no count of seasonal vs nightly sites is given; nightly rates are posted, so tests 2-3 pass; 4 can't be measured.

Waterfront lead: stored 'lakefront', but the only lakefront sites the park names are seasonal ('Premium Lakefront $2,670' in the 2027 seasonal rates). If transient sites don't front the 8-acre lake, the call should come down - worth a re-check of which pads are on the shore.
Season stays as stored (late Apr-early Oct, from the association listing 'Open 4-24 to 10-4' / '4/28 thru 10/7'); the park's own site gives no dates.
